versions.changelog: Standardize conversational summaries around Today at a glance, What you did, App table, and Caveats; keep reduced output opt-in.

- Removed unnecessary files: Python bytecode cache and the skill card documentation.
- No changes to functionality or user-facing documentation.
- Cleanup improves repository clarity and maintainability.
Move the skill to the repository-root skills/ layout for Codex and cross-platform registry discovery.

- Initial release of computer-usage-summary.  
- Summarizes user activity on macOS, Windows, or Linux using local ActivityWatch records.  
- Privacy-focused: uses only foreground app and AFK data, never infers from logs or browser history unless explicitly permitted.  
- Offers structured daily, weekly, or monthly summaries and prepares spreadsheet-ready tables (TSV/CSV/Markdown).  
- Screen Time or app/activity snapshots used only as fallback, always clearly labeled.  
- Local-only: Never uploads or exports data without explicit user consent.

- Initial release of computer-usage-summary, supporting local summary of app usage and AFK time on macOS, Windows, and Linux using ActivityWatch data.
- Provides daily, weekly, or custom date range reports using only local foreground app, sanitized window title, and AFK event data.
- Strong privacy focus: avoids cloud sync, browser extensions, and direct database reads; window titles are sanitized; no data leaves the device without user consent.
- Screen Time and snapshot-based fallbacks included when ActivityWatch data is unavailable, with clear reporting of unavailability reasons.
- Offers multiple output formats (Markdown, TSV, CSV) for ready-to-use spreadsheet reporting, including optional project/client breakdowns via local rule files.
